does: Scores for the AI the action resources an action costs against what the character has.

evidence.says: walks the action's eoc::action_resource::ActionResourceCost array against eoc::ActionResourcesComponent of the character
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 1 place, the function at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x37726F0
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
